const binaryData = $binary?.data;
let transcript = '';
if (binaryData?.data) {
  transcript = Buffer.from(binaryData.data, 'base64').toString('utf-8').substring(0, 6000);
}

const systemPrompt = [
  'You are processing call transcripts and WhatsApp exports for WHEN Travel, a travel savings coaching platform based in India.',
  'Extract structured CRM data and return ONLY a valid JSON object — no preamble, no markdown, no code fences.',
  '',
  'Extract these fields (use null for anything not mentioned or not clear):',
  '',
  '{',
  '  "name": "client first name only",',
  '  "email": "email address if mentioned or null",',
  '  "phone": "phone number if mentioned or null",',
  '  "source": "how they found WHEN Travel e.g. referral/instagram/whatsapp/other or null",',
  '',
  '  "pref_beach": true or false or null,',
  '  "pref_mountain": true or false or null,',
  '  "pref_culture": true or false or null,',
  '  "pref_unique": true or false or null (off-beat / unusual destinations),',
  '  "pref_city": true or false or null,',
  '  "travel_style": "budget or mid-range or luxury or null",',
  '  "trip_budget": "total trip budget as string e.g. 1.5L or 80000 or null",',
  '',
  '  "monthly_savings": number in INR or null,',
  '  "already_saving": true or false or null,',
  '  "existing_savings": "description of current savings e.g. 20k in FD or null",',
  '  "savings_instruments": "PPF FD mutual funds etc or null",',
  '  "cards_owned": "credit card names if mentioned or null",',
  '',
  '  "blocker_no": true or false (says they have no money),',
  '  "blocker_unsure": true or false (unsure about whether to travel),',
  '  "blocker_key": true or false (some specific key concern blocks them),',
  '  "blocker_date": true or false (uncertain about travel dates),',
  '  "blocker_already": true or false (already have conflicting plans),',
  '  "blocker_other": "describe any other blocker or null",',
  '',
  '  "destination_primary": "main destination they want or null",',
  '  "destination_alternative": "backup or second-choice destination or null",',
  '  "trip_timeline": "when they want to travel e.g. March 2026 or in 6 months or null",',
  '  "trip_type": "solo or couple or family or group or null",',
  '  "booking_details": "any flights or hotels already booked or null",',
  '  "calendly_link": "link if shared or null",',
  '',
  '  "m1_flights": true or false or null (flights booked),',
  '  "m2_accommodation": true or false or null (accommodation booked),',
  '  "m3_food": true or false or null (food budget sorted),',
  '  "m4_activities": true or false or null (activities planned),',
  '  "m5_transport": true or false or null (local transport arranged),',
  '  "trigger_moment": "the emotional catalyst that made them want this trip or null",',
  '  "confidence_score": number 1-10 how confident they seem about actually doing the trip,',
  '  "success_visibility": "how they imagine the trip feeling or null",',
  '',
  '  "value_points": "transformation or value they want from travel or null",',
  '  "pain_points": "their main financial or emotional struggles or null",',
  '',
  '  "hot_cold": "hot or warm or cold — how ready they are to take action",',
  '  "journey_stage": "Discovery Done or Plan Delivered or Active Saver or Milestone Unlocked or Trip Completed",',
  '  "persona": "one-word archetype: Dreamer Planner Hustler Worrier or Explorer",',
  '  "next_action": "recommended next step for the coach or null",',
  '  "feedback_quote": "a positive or reflective quote from them or null",',
  '  "key_quotes": "most impactful 1-2 things they said or null",',
  '',
  '  "ai_recommendation": "brief 1-sentence coaching recommendation based on their profile",',
  '  "follow_up_priority": "high or medium or low",',
  '  "sentiment_score": number 1-10 overall positivity and readiness,',
  '  "objection_type": "financial or timing or uncertainty or family or other or null",',
  '  "predicted_timeline": "when they are likely to book e.g. within 1 month or next quarter or null"',
  '}',
  '',
  'Journey stage rules:',
  '- Discovery Done: first intake/discovery call, no plan delivered yet',
  '- Plan Delivered: coach has sent or mentioned sending a savings plan',
  '- Active Saver: client is actively tracking their savings progress',
  '- Milestone Unlocked: client has booked flights or accommodation',
  '- Trip Completed: trip has already happened'
].join('\n');

const requestBody = JSON.stringify({
  model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001',
  max_tokens: 2048,
  system: systemPrompt,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: transcript || 'No transcript content available.' }]
});

return { json: { requestBody, filename: $('Loop Docs').item.json.name } };

## CRM Sync from Transcripts v3

Reads all Google Docs in the transcripts folder, extracts CRM fields via Claude Haiku (55 fields across G1–G9), then creates or updates records in Attio.

**Google Drive folder:** 1W3wLJTBeXuFcBaWVNpCHnyenFIoc2gRY
**Attio list:** 4bd161bd-2b58-4c11-9ee5-004257444bb2

**Before deploying:** Run tools/attio-setup/create-fields.sh to create the custom fields in Attio.

**Groups:** G1 Identity · G2 Travel Prefs · G3 Financial · G4 Blockers · G5 Current Trip · G6 Milestones · G7 JTBD · G8 Engagement · G9 Actions & Intelligence
